meta.title: About BAFIK Medical Congress
meta.description: Discover BAFIK: technical and scientific partner of African medical learned societies.

hero.title: Audiovisual excellence serving African medicine
hero.subtitle: For years, BAFIK has supported learned societies, medical faculties, and organizing committees in producing, broadcasting, and amplifying scientific congresses.

mission.title: Transforming each congress into a scientific reference
mission.p1: In Africa, medical congresses are vital crossroads for knowledge sharing, clinical presentations, and public health harmonization. Yet too many valuable discussions end once the closing ceremony finishes.
mission.p2: BAFIK's mission is two-fold: ensuring flawless on-site execution (scientific AV booth, 4K recording, simultaneous translation, hybrid live streaming), and elevating that content into long-lasting tools for continuing medical education.

pillars.title: Three uncompromising standards behind every event

p1.title: Scientific Rigor & Medical Culture
p1.description: Our teams understand the codes, rhythm, and constraints of medical meetings: strict timekeeping, abstract compliance, and discreet operation.

p2.title: Top-tier Technical Quality
p2.description: Robotic camera systems, multi-feed broadcast switchers, live surgical feeds, and bonded high-speed uplinks for uninterrupted streaming.

p3.title: Enduring Scientific Impact
p3.description: We extend the lifespan of clinical insights through concise video capsules, indexed chaptered replays, and modular e-learning resources.

meta.title: Augmented Congress — The BAFIK Methodology
meta.description: Extend the reach of your medical congress: video capsules, chaptered replays, podcasts, and continuing education modules.

hero.title: The Augmented Congress: your event continues well after closing day
hero.subtitle: Discover our methodology that turns every keynote and symposium into an enduring educational and scientific asset.

intro.title: Why 80% of congress value disappears after closing day
intro.text: Months of preparation, world-class speakers, groundbreaking clinical cases... and days later, often only a paper book of abstracts remains. BAFIK changes that through a structured 4-step post-congress amplification workflow.

deliverables.title: What we create for your medical society

replays.title: Chaptered & Indexed Replays
replays.description: Every presentation is edited in high definition with synchronized slides, divided by speaker and clinical topic for instant search.

podcast.title: Scientific Audio Podcasts
podcast.description: Audio feeds optimized for busy hospital physicians and specialists listening on the go.
